signal: Filevine raised $400M at a $3B valuation and in June 2026 launched its Legal Operating Intelligence System (LOIS) after acquiring Pincites for AI contract intelligence.

email.body1:
Madison, saw Filevine launched LOIS and raised $400M at a $3B valuation.

Growth at that pace usually means more in-market firms in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Madison, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many booked meetings it takes to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Filevine needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Madison, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth legaltech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Madison, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a big raise and launch, I know the GTM stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your legaltech motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
